digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime authentication and provider session construction
propositions: Provider-native auth capabilities (e.g. boto3 Session, Anthropic token provider, OpenAI workload identity) must be accepted by PydanticAIRunner/get_runner and passed to the single per-run ProviderSession without forking the RP-01 authorization path
Auth credentials must be non-serializable, excluded from LLMConfig/RunRequest/snapshots/fingerprints/caches/schemas/output, and remain scoped only to the official SDK client builder
Missing or conflicting explicit provider auth must fail before any model request, with no fallback to anonymous/alternate-principal/cross-provider alternatives
The RP-01 authoritative behavior (request budget, output repair, cache, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, failure handling) and one-Agent-per-run contract must remain unchanged
Native SDK refresh, expiry, and workload identity lifecycle remain under the provider SDK's ownership, not Rebar's
